name: CAMS_EVENT_VERIFICATION
what: Whether CAMS forecasts caught pollution and dust events at a point, by lead time: detection rate, false alarms and bias above a percentile threshold. Events, not averages — a product can track the mean and miss every spike.
tableNote: Not a relationship table. Its rows describe how a forecast performed at a point, which is a statement about the dataset rather than a relation between two features, and the registry has no object type that fits a site. It was registered as Dataset-to-Basin once and that was wrong.
note: The number is a position and is recomputed whenever a dataset is added. Quote the name, never the number.
